sections.tbbSubtitle: Union of Municipalities of Türkiye and Project Activities
sections.tbbText1: <0>Strengthening the institutional capacities of municipalities</0>, enhancing cooperation and coordination among local governments, and promoting a culture of mutual learning are among the key priority areas of the Union of Municipalities of Türkiye (TBB).
sections.tbbText2: Within this framework, the <0>Municipal Forum (BELFOR)</0> provides an important platform for municipalities to share their experiences and jointly evaluate examples of good practice. At the Municipal Forum (BELFOR), we introduced our Equal Workplace Project to <1>more than 100 municipalities</1> and shared our experiences and practices with participating local governments.

about.title: ABOUT US
about.subtitle: A comprehensive social initiative designed to promote the principles of equality, diversity, and inclusion in the workplace.
about.whatTitle: What is the Equal Workplace Project?
about.whatText: As Büyükçekmece Municipality, we launched the Equal Workplace Project to raise awareness of gender equality, increase the number of women entrepreneurs, and support women in taking an active role in society as modern and empowered individuals.
about.whyText:
Businesses awarded the Equal Workplace Certificate will benefit from:
· A 50% discount on business license fees
· A 50% discount on signage and advertising fees
about.conditionText:
· At least 50% of the employees at the workplace must be women.
· Women and men performing equal work must receive equal pay.
· The workplace must employ at least two employees, excluding the employer(s).
· Businesses providing services exclusively to women are excluded from the scope of this project. Eligibility in such cases will be assessed by the Equal Workplace Commission.
· Businesses awarded the Equal Workplace Certificate must continue to meet the above requirements. If these conditions are no longer fulfilled, the Equal Workplace Commission may revoke the certificate and the benefits granted under the project.

president.title: MAYOR’S MESSAGE
president.text:
The aim of our Equal Workplace Project is to raise awareness of gender equality across our city, increase the number of women entrepreneurs, and support women in taking active roles at every level of professional life—from production to management—as modern, empowered individuals.

Through this project, we place particular importance on promoting equality between women and men in all areas of social life and in the workplace, while fostering and maintaining a fair and balanced working environment.
